reason: Faker 5 inside Newman (postman-collection), used only for {{$random...}} variables. The collection has none, and the exploit needs an attacker-written template. The fix is Faker 10, which Newman doesn't support yet.
Denial of service on attacker-supplied brace patterns, inside the HTML reporter's template helpers. The reporter only renders our own run results on the CI machine. No fixed braces release exists.
RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification, inside Newman's runtime for certificate and signing auth types. The collection uses neither (one bearer header). 1.4.0, the latest release, is still affected.

Inside promptfoo, through jks-js, which reads Java keystores for client certificates in its HTTP provider. This package runs only a local replay provider: no HTTP provider, no certificates. 1.4.0, the latest release, is still affected.

Inside promptfoo's proxy support (proxy-agent > pac-proxy-agent > get-uri), reached only when a PAC proxy file is fetched over ftp://. No proxy is configured and the eval makes no network calls. Fixed only in basic-ftp 6, which get-uri 8 does not accept.
Inside chokidar 3, the optional file watcher nunjucks loads for template watch mode. promptfoo renders our own prompt template once and never watches it. No fixed braces release exists.
